chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Prolonged sitting in the place of relieving oneself causes hemorrhoids.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about sitting too long in the restroom?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a practical etiquette related to relieving oneself, warning against remaining seated there for too long. It indicates a harmful bodily consequence and reflects the Islamic concern for health, cleanliness, and proper personal conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.56 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"Prolonged sitting in the restroom causes hemorrhoids”.
